Lee Stewart and all his staff are taking a vacation from the chilly autumn streets of Winnipeg and heading for the sunny coast of Vice City, the fictitious setting of the latest Rockstar Games release, Grand Theft Auto VI. They're far from alone.
After a 13-year wait, one of entertainment’s biggest releases is finally here.
